meta.title: Material 3 theme
meta.description: Recolours the interface with Material You roles derived from a seed colour.

page.title: Material 3 theme
page.description: Material You colour roles derived from one seed colour. Light and dark are generated together, so the two palettes always agree.
page.enabledDescription: Recolours surfaces, labels, borders and state colours with Material 3 roles. Turn it off to return to the theme you had before.
page.seedDescription: The source colour the whole palette is derived from.
page.variantDescription: How far the palette departs from the seed. Tonal spot is the Material 3 default; expressive follows the Material 3 Expressive reading.
page.note: Changes apply immediately and are remembered in this browser, so they survive a reload without restarting the harness.
